subject.title: [Feature]: REST endpoint for session management in HTTP API integrations

question: Should OpenClaw expose a narrow public `/v1/sessions/*` HTTP session-management API for OpenAI-compatible integrations, or should HTTP-only session control remain on WebSocket and the opt-in admin HTTP RPC plugin?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding mutating session controls to the `/v1` HTTP surface changes a public integration and security boundary that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve narrow `/v1/sessions/*` API
options.body: Implement reset/status/compact/model/reasoning endpoints with explicit operator-scope mapping, docs, route tests, and no slash-command re-enablement.

options.title: Use admin HTTP RPC only
options.body: Document the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin as the supported trusted-host HTTP workaround and keep `/v1/chat/completions` focused on chat turns.

options.title: Approve reset/status first
options.body: Start with status plus reset as the common workflow, then defer model/reasoning/compaction until the HTTP security model is proven.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow `/v1/sessions/*` API
recommendation.body: Implement reset/status/compact/model/reasoning endpoints with explicit operator-scope mapping, docs, route tests, and no slash-command re-enablement.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` HTTP surface where vincentkoc has the strongest recent history signal.
